method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 11, compilation date 5 December 2025 (includes amendments up to Act No. 72, 2025), register id C2025C00665, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2012A00168.txt; penalty unit from Crimes Act 1914 s 4AA and body corporate multiplier from s 4B(3) (Compilation No. 167, 27 August 2026, ../../../crimes-act-1914/registers/source-bundle/C1914A00012.txt), the indexed penalty unit an input; Australian Charities and Not-for-profits Commission Regulations 2022 NOT DEPOSITED (governance standards, external conduct standards and any prescribed size thresholds are inputs)
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under CC BY 4.0 with the attribution in ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run acnc-cases-duties.l4 ; l4 run acnc-cases-registration.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the founder of a charity and director of its trustee company (a responsible person), for the 2 events of the WA cradle-to-grave lives that cite the Act (Daniel d072, d091): s 20-5 (what registration gives), s 25-5 (entitlement as a charity and as a subtype, the table as data), ss 30-10, 30-15(2)-(4), 30-20, 30-25, 30-30, 30-35, ss 35-5(2), 35-10(1), (3), (4), 35-15, 35-20 (revocation, show cause), ss 40-5(1)(c), (2), 40-10 (the Register), ss 160-5, 160-10 (objections); s 45-10(1), (5), (6) (governance standards -- their content is in the undeposited Regulations, so compliance is an input), s 55-5 (records, offence), s 205-25 (size), ss 60-5, 60-10, 60-20, 60-25, 60-60, 60-65, 60-85(2)(b) (reporting), s 65-5 (duty to notify), ss 205-15, 205-30, 205-35, s 80-5, ss 100-5, 100-10, 100-15, 100-20, 100-25 (warning, suspension and removal of responsible entities), ss 175-10, 175-20, 175-25, 175-30, 175-35, 175-40 (administrative penalties), ss 180-20, 180-25 (trust obligations, liabilities and offences). Inputs: the penalty unit, revenue under accounting standards, size thresholds, compliance with the standards, every belief or opinion of the Commissioner, Charities Act 2013 'charity', 'not-for-profit entity', constitutional corporation. Left out: the content of the governance and external conduct standards (Regulations), Division 50, financial report contents and audit (ss 60-15, 60-30 to 60-55), additional and collective reporting, Divisions 70, 75, 85, 90, 95, acting responsible entities, secrecy, objection decisions and ART review, remission and the general interest charge, Subdivisions 180-B and 180-D, the ACNC, Commissioner and Advisory Board.
seat: the founder of a charity and director of its trustee company -- a responsible person (responsible entity) of the registered entity (Daniel and, from 2076, his children, as directors of the Rossi Foundation's trustee company)
